subject.title: fix(doctor): seed plugins.allow from installed extensions when allowlist is unset

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` automatically convert previously installed plugins into explicit trust, and if so, which persisted provenance is sufficient?
rationale: Current documentation marks the missing allowlist finding as non-auto-fixable, while the PR changes both plugin trust policy and upgrade behavior; repository evidence cannot establish that filesystem directory presence is an approved authorization source.

options.title: Trust tracked installs only
options.body: Allow doctor to seed IDs backed by the durable plugin install index, preserve bundled discovery compatibility, and continue warning about untracked directories.

options.title: Require operator confirmation
options.body: Have doctor display discovered IDs and require explicit confirmation before writing the allowlist, including in interactive repair flows.

options.title: Keep manual hardening
options.body: Retain the current non-auto-fixable audit warning and require operators to configure trusted plugin IDs themselves.

recommendation.title: Trust tracked installs only
recommendation.body: Allow doctor to seed IDs backed by the durable plugin install index, preserve bundled discovery compatibility, and continue warning about untracked directories.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available merged history for explicit plugin-install allowlist policy points to this owner.
